context: A young niece chats with her aunt about an old superstition
purpose: Teach: しまえ/下さっ/除い/見つから/去っ/あけ/行なう/曰く

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おばちゃん、夜中に口笛吹くと悪魔が来るって本当？
lines.en: Auntie, is it true a demon comes if you whistle at night?
lines.style: Child curious voice, wide-eyed and slightly worried tone

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ふふ、おばあちゃん曰く、夜に口笛を吹く子は早く寝てしまえって言われたのよ。
lines.en: Hehe, Grandma used to say kids who whistle at night should just hurry off to sleep already.
lines.style: Warm aunt voice, amused and gently teasing the niece

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: えー、じゃあ天使は来てくれないの？
lines.en: Eh, so an angel won't come instead?
lines.style: Child pouty voice, slightly disappointed and bargaining

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 天使は神様が遣わして下さった使いだから、夜更かしっ子のところには見つからないかもね。
lines.en: Angels are messengers God sent down, so they probably can't be found around night-owl kids.
lines.style: Aunt explaining voice, playful but pretending to be serious

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 怖いの除いてほしいなあ。本当に悪魔っているの？
lines.en: I want the scary part taken away. Do demons really exist?
lines.style: Child anxious voice, seeking reassurance from a trusted adult

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 昔の人はね、悪い気を払う儀式を行なう習慣があったんだって。
lines.en: Long ago, people apparently had a custom of performing rituals to drive bad spirits away.
lines.style: Aunt storytelling voice, slow and slightly mysterious for effect

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 夜があけたら悪いものは全部去っていくって信じてたのよ。
lines.en: They believed once dawn broke, all the bad things would leave for good.
lines.style: Aunt soothing voice, soft and reassuring to calm the child

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: じゃあ朝になったら窓をあけて、悪いの全部追い出せばいいんだね！
lines.en: Then when morning comes, I'll open the window and chase all the bad stuff out!
lines.style: Child bright voice, suddenly cheerful and proud of the idea

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: そうそう、ヒナちゃんは賢いね。今夜はぐっすり眠っちゃおうね。
lines.en: Exactly, Hina, you're so clever. Let's get a good night's sleep tonight.
lines.style: Aunt affectionate voice, soft and warmly approving the child
